'''Wild Byth's''' was an underworld haven that was in existence during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Red Blade]], a notorious [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], regularly docked at ports such as [[Port Nowhere]] and Wild Byth's to celebrate raids.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=codex|Intelligence Profile: The Red Blade}}</ref>
